description: This Java class 'MockMeteringCluster' simulates a cluster of metering devices, providing methods to set and retrieve power consumption attributes such as watts, multiplier, and divisor. It extends 'MockCluster' and interacts with attribute report events.

classes.name: MockMeteringCluster
classes.description: A mock class representing a metering cluster, used for testing or simulating meter readings and attributes in a Zigbee-like environment.

methods.name: setInstantaneousDemand
methods.description: Sets the instantaneous demand value and triggers reporting.

methods.name: setMultiplier
methods.description: Sets the multiplier attribute for metering calculations.

methods.name: setDivisor
methods.description: Sets the divisor attribute for metering calculations.

methods.name: setWatts
methods.description: Sets the watts (power consumption) and sends an attribute report.

methods.name: getMyBytes
methods.description: Converts a 24-bit integer into a three-byte array for attribute data formatting.

methods.name: getAttributeData
methods.description: Overrides method to return the attribute data bytes based on attribute ID.
